notes: Income, work hours, replacement, costs, volume, risk floors and stress loading are editable design assumptions, not measured rider losses or a sales forecast.
Capital duration includes 24 hours from purchase to effect, coverage, and 168 hours of claim grace.
Historical climate prices apply to precommitted calendar batches only; instant weather-selected retail requires separately validated conditional risk forecasts.
The year-block bootstrap quantile is an estimation diagnostic, not a guaranteed confidence bound or a guarantee of future profit.
Existing archive caches did not pin the source model; they are reproducible research inputs, not verified homogeneous ERA5 or station observations.
